About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

Vercel started as the home for frontends. The Languages and Runtimes team is making it the home for the rest of the application: APIs, background workers, AI agents, and the services that connect them. This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always-on background workers to the platform.

Our work spans the path from source code to a running process: tooling that understands an application’s structure, packages its dependencies, and runs it on Vercel, plus language runtimes, SDKs, private service-to-service communication, and production observability. Much of it is making existing applications run efficiently without asking developers to rework them, whether that means taming large dependency sets, cutting cold starts, precompiling Python bytecode at build time, or serving a framework’s static assets straight from the CDN.

Next, we’re bringing first-class support to Go and Rust, from builds and packaging to runtime integration and SDKs, and improving observability so developers can see how their services connect and where requests spend their time. You’ll work across these layers, following problems from a developer’s application down to how it builds and executes.

What You Will Do:

- Build and maintain backend services and infrastructure using Python and Rust.

- Improve serverless Python execution, including dependency management, runtime behavior, startup performance, and resource efficiency.

- Design distributed systems that support reliable deployment and execution of customer applications and AI workloads.

- Develop cloud infrastructure and deployment automation using Infrastructure as Code.

- Investigate performance bottlenecks and production issues across services, runtimes, and infrastructure.

- Partner with engineering and product teams to turn developer needs into reliable platform capabilities.

- Own the services you ship, including monitoring, incident response, and participation in an on-call rotation.

About You:

- Experience shipping and operating backend software in production, with strong Python skills and practical experience with Rust.

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS, and an understanding of compute, networking, storage, and service deployment.

- Familiarity with distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and the tradeoffs involved in building reliable services.

- Experience with containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Inclusive healthcare package.

- Mentorship and opportunities to attend events that build your network and skills.

- Flexible time off.

- Equipment and a work-from-home budget to set up your workspace.

As a Full-Stack Engineer at Superhuman, you will play a critical role in building core parts of the Superhuman product offering, infrastructure, and features to help 40 million users write more clearly and effectively every day. You’ll have the opportunity to work across both Front-End and Back-End, contributing to highly visible, impactful projects.
  
  
Superhuman engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog.
  
  
Superhuman is growing rapidly. There are opportunities to join a team, learn from experienced peers, and build product offerings and teams from the ground up. Within our growing engineering organization, there is plenty of room for ownership and direct impact on users.
  
  
**As a Full-Stack Engineer, You Will**

* Start building and pushing code in your first week and ship impactful features in your first few months.
* Build and support production services with high call rates on the Back-End and develop rich user interfaces on the Front-End.
* Target high availability for consumer and enterprise customers.
* Learn how to build infrastructure as code (IaC).
* Collaborate widely with internal teams such as Core, Growth, Enterprise, Trust, and Data to deliver delightful product offerings to our customers.
* Contribute to an engineering culture with a strong emphasis on documentation, testing, and user experience.
* Evaluate the systems and technology in place today while proposing systems and architecture that can scale for the future.
* Have the opportunity to mentor new hires.

**Qualifications**

* Brings at least three years of experience in Full-Stack development.
* Displays excellent software engineering fundamentals, including knowledge of algorithms and data structures.
* Is ready to tackle infrastructure challenges when needed.
* Knows modern web client development and testing tools.
* Has experience building, deploying, and debugging production systems at scale.
* Demonstrates perseverance when faced with tough technical issues.
* Cares about the end-user experience and strives to ensure high quality.
* Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments

We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower!
